changed.what: Applied U29a's request: the in-tree probe and capture script also record the 960-step two-second rollout digest (rollout_2s_digest, h passed as f64 1.0/480.0, zero torques, reference state) in the fixture and its capture record; the candidate rollout is compared with it as the §43.3 M0 artifact, recorded beside the gate digest and not a clause of INT-FSIM-01. Added test g1_rollout_2s_digest_matches_oracle, a fourth planted capture fixture, an acceptance line, and logging of both digests on both sides. Scope checked against the 61-dependents finding: still the smallest unit that delivers RefereeDynamics v0 and the gate digest.

The acceptance line on FrankenSim's constellation.lock was unmeetable as worded: the receipt's own_lock is one class for the whole file, and its other stale rows are FD-FSIM-16's at M1. It now requires the asupersync row to equal Cargo.lock (FD-ASUP-01's test) and the checkout to be on-pin and clean; own_lock agrees:false from the other rows is recorded and is not a failure.

Applied U33a's request: a tier of the enumeration not implemented at M0 is 724 (exit 5); a value outside it, such as refere, is 802 (exit 3, pointer /tier). Test tier_misspelt_802 and e2e step 6 added. seconds must give a whole number of 1/480 s steps, else 802 at /seconds and never rounded (test seconds_whole_steps). A fixture other than g1, or worlds other than 1, is 724. Dependency BD-023 added, because the e2e and the acceptance call the sim_run tool through frob-mcp.

Fixed an ordering conflict: BD-037 depends on this bead (BD-037 -> BD-023 -> BD-008 -> FD-ASUP-01), so the registry, its frob doctor section and N33b-04's scripted train all come after it. The bead now opens its own fixture in BD-037's form, runs its switch-over by its four written steps, and hands BD-037 the row content in its closing record. The INT-ASUP-01 acceptance is split into the precondition measured here and BD-008's first gate run at the new pins. The e2e calls frob doctor only when that section exists, otherwise logs not-run. Dependencies N33c-09 and N34-03 added: they hold the check-deps rules its interim-posture controls run. Stale NF-01 reference changed to N33b-04.
Dependency BD-024 added: its post phase runs frob sim run g1 --tier referee --seconds 2, which BD-024 provides.

The post phase runs frob sim run on a one-body fixture with an authored external wrench, which no bead before N26a-02 (M3) accepts; BD-024 at M0 takes only g1 with no disturbances. That step is now logged not-run with its key and never counted as passed; the GATE-WS-06 mixed-wrench probe at the new pin carries the adoption.
The acceptance and the test now name the beads of the capacity row's consequence, N33a-14 and BET-34, instead of 'the two beads that lean on it'.

Applied U33b's request: harness gains fs-la (oracle only), with the reason. Applied U33c's request: the mode pair is filled by N33c-11, every group feature implies mode-inproc, mode-remote enables no group, no-group builds use --no-default-features --features mode-inproc, and test every_group_feature_implies_inproc is added. frob-verbs added to the referee consumers, marked DESIGN with its reason (BD-024's M0 handler and the doctor section call the airlock before frob-dyn exists). The out-of-scope adapters are named by key (N33b-11 to N33b-16). The e2e duration 0.01 s (4.8 steps) becomes 0.025 s (12 steps).

Fixed attributions: 791 is raised by N33c-13, not BD-038; 790's value is in N33a-11 and its envelope in N33c-32. The 792 pointer is referee/<crate>/<variant> with payload kind per N33-REF, so the OutsideDomain repair no longer points at pointer. Test into_workspace_refusal_upstream_792 added. On the graph finding: the N16-REF dependency is kept and N16-REF is asked to move to M0.
KA-778 control wording corrected: 22 contacts against capacity 21 refuse with 721, and 21 run. The no-group doctor test now builds with mode-inproc, as N33c-11's exactly-one-mode rule requires.

Step 1 used --seconds 0.01, which is not a whole number of 1/480 s steps and would now be refused with 802 before 790; changed to 0.025 (12 steps). The stale 'request recorded' note is replaced by BD-024's now-explicit rule.

On the graph finding (70 direct dependents): the first real train of FrankenSim at M0 moved to the new bead N33bp2-01, so the procedure that every upstream item needs is not held up by a real upstream head. Title, scope, section 5, acceptance and the NF-01 note adjusted. The guard tests now assert that each synthetic run's log validates against frob.e2elog/1 and ends with a summary.
Now depends on N33bp2-01. Its Out list names that bead, and the ADR acceptance records the first real train's train_id, outcome and receipt_after.
Out list: the upstream alignment is FD-ASUP-01, which BD-008 depends on, not BD-008.

Step 7 specified as h = 1/480 s and 960 steps of BD-007's step_free. Its digest is compared with FrankenSim's own rollout_2s_digest from BD-007's capture; the comparison is recorded and is not a gate. Record fields, acceptance, assert line and known answers updated; the 'no known answer yet' consideration replaced.

It covers the first real compatibility train of FrankenSim at M0: run end to end by scripts/e2e/first_train_fsim.sh with NDJSON logging; both outcomes recorded; the evidence record and its consistency test with five planted copies; G1 digests recaptured at the new pin; cited by the KILL-FSIM ADR. requests.what: Move to M0, which is preferred over a split. This reinforces S22's round-1 request. N33a-13 (M0) depends on it because the conversion and N33a-14's capacity check raise FROB-REF-721 and -224 at M0, so those rows must load at M0. All of N16-REF's own dependencies (BD-005, BD-022, N32a-03, N35-33, STD-E2E) are M0. With the move, the unadmitted edge N33a-13 -> N16-REF becomes valid.

Its restated group table gives referee and geometry as 'any core crate of layer 2 or above'. N33a-11's records, which govern, name explicit lists: referee -> frob-model, frob-dyn, frob-contact, frob-analyze, frob-verbs (added in round 2 for BD-024's M0 handler and the doctor referee section), frob-conformance; geometry -> frob-contact, frob-scene, frob-foundry, frob-conformance. Restate them exactly.

FD-ASUP-01 precedes BD-037 in the graph (BD-037 -> BD-023 -> BD-008 -> FD-ASUP-01). It now opens tests/upstream/FD-ASUP-01/ itself in BD-037's fixture form and hands over its registry row (mirror ids, status landed or adopted) in its closing record. BD-037 should state that it adopts that fixture unchanged, enters the FD-ASUP-01 row from that record, and covers it in its registry check.
Its Out list says 'the first pin move of FrankenSim, in N33b-04'. That run was split in round 2 into N33bp2-01; update the reference.

List the new child N33bp2-01 (the first real train of FrankenSim at M0) and N33b-04's new title: 'compatibility train: the pin-advance procedure and script, its guards, the train log with the breakage share'.
